#NOWSHOWING: PELIKULAYA @ SM CINEMAS! 🌈

The wait is over, Metro Manila! Catch the powerful lineup of pride stories exploring identity, connection, and belonging on the big screen at SM Megamall, SM North Edsa, SM Manila, and SM Mall of Asia from June 21–29, 2025.

FEATURED FILMS: 

🎬 “Young Hearts” by Anthony Schatteman
🎬 “Portrait of a Lady on Fire” by Céline Sciamma
🎬 “Pierce” by Nelicia Low

Bring your friends and invite your family —these stories are meant to be understood, felt, and remembered.

👉 Reserve your seats now: https://t.co/LcRdKtxMmE

Happy Pride, mga mahal! 

#FDCP #MovieOn #PhilippineCinema #PelikulayaEncounters #PrideMonth
